newsitem.title: USA: Triumph Group acquires JD Chapdelaine.
newsitem.headline: Triumph Group acquires JD Chapdelaine.

text.p: Triumph Group Inc said Thursday that it acquired J.D. Chapdelaine Co for an undisclosed amount of cash and notes.
Chapdelaine repairs, overhauls and exchanges electromechanical aircraft instruments for aircraft ranging from single-engine piston airplanes to wide-body air transport.

Richard C. Ill, Triumph's president and chief executive officer, said the acquisition extends the company's reach to the Central and Eastern United States from its current repair and overhaul bases in Seattle and Glendale, California.
Triumph Group designs, engineers, manufactures, repairs and overhauls aircraft components.
